params.initialApprovers: Addresses authorized to propose and vote.
params.initialQuorum: Votes required to pass a proposal.

params.amounts: Must match the amounts encoded at proposal creation time.
params.proposalId: Must match a stored, approved, non-expired proposal.
params.recipients: Must match the recipients encoded at proposal creation time.

params.expiresAt: Unix timestamp after which the proposal cannot be voted on or executed.                    Must be [now + 1h, now + 30d].
params.proposalId: Caller-supplied unique id (bytes32).                    Recommended: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(offChainId, msg.sender, block.timestamp))

MAX_BATCH_SIZE().notice: Maximum recipients in a single PAYROLL_BATCH proposal.

balance().notice: Current USDC balance held by this contract.

cancel(bytes32).notice: Cancel a proposal.  No funds move.         Only the owner may cancel.  Cannot cancel an already-executed proposal.

deposit(uint256).notice: Pull USDC from msg.sender into this contract.         Caller must USDC.approve(address(this), amount) first.         Only call this to fund the treasury — do not send raw ETH.

execute(bytes32,address[],uint256[]).notice: Execute an approved, non-expired proposal. TRANSFER proposals: transfers USDC to the single recipient. PAYROLL proposals:  atomically transfers USDC to all recipients.                     If any individual transfer fails, the entire call reverts. CONFIG proposals:   updates the approver set and quorum. Security properties:   - contentHash is recomputed from the supplied arrays and compared to storage.     Any payload substitution (different recipients, amounts, or expiry) reverts.   - balance is checked at execution time (no-escrow model).   - nonReentrant guard from ReentrancyGuard (prevents re-entry during USDC transfers).   - executed flag is set before any external call (CEI pattern).

proposeConfigChange(bytes32,address[],ui.notice: Create a CONFIG_CHANGE proposal to update the approver set and/or quorum. The new approvers and quorum are encoded as amounts/recipients so the same contentHash mechanism binds the governance payload too. Encoding:   recipients[i] = newApprovers[i]  (as address, not used as amount)   amounts[0]    = uint256(newQuorum)   amounts[i>0]  = 0  (unused, required for array length match) This is intentionally simple for a hackathon demo.  A production version would use dedicated ABI-encoded calldata fields.

proposePayroll(bytes32,address[],uint256.notice: Create a PAYROLL_BATCH proposal (multiple recipients, atomic).

quorum().notice: Minimum number of distinct approver votes to pass a proposal.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Transfer treasury ownership to a new address.         The new owner can cancel proposals and fund the treasury.         To also retain governance control, the new owner should be         included in a subsequent CONFIG_CHANGE proposal.

usdc().notice: The USDC ERC-20 token.  Immutable after deploy.

vote(bytes32).notice: Cast an approval vote for a proposal. Rules:   - Only addresses in the approver set may vote.   - The proposer cannot vote on their own proposal (self-vote guard).   - Each address may vote exactly once per proposal.   - Expired, cancelled, and already-executed proposals cannot be voted on.
